session: 2026-08-28 post-cleanroom shipping hotfix — source-fixture credential scrubbing and the Netlify secret-scan gate

workstreams.title: P1 — sanitize captured public pages, record their provenance, and gate the class in CI before Netlify sees it (NH280)

serializationNotes: ONE workstream, and the decomposition is proportional rather than performed. Every deliverable in this hotfix consumes `sanitizeText`/`writeCapturedFixture` from `lib/ops/fixture-credentials.ts`, which did not exist until this session built it: the fixture repair calls it, the provenance record is generated from its output, the committed-fixture guard asserts against its classes, and the two recorders (`learn-legistar-horizon.mts`, `hunt-azleg-actions.mts`) route their writes through it. That is a produces/consumes handoff, not a preference — the chain is sanitizer -> repaired fixtures -> generated provenance -> guard, and no link is executable before the one behind it.

The one candidate for a second stream was the recorder wiring, which touches different files and shares no store with the fixture repair. It was not run beside the repair because it CONSUMES `writeCapturedFixture`; splitting it would have produced a branch that could not compile until the other landed.

No serialization here is justified by PR size, branch simplicity, conflict avoidance, convenience, or the absence of subagents. The brief authorized a single narrow hotfix branch, and the dependency graph independently agrees with it.
